description: Pre-scaffold completeness gate for Core 30 pages. Verifies city/service/client data files have every field the templates reference. Missing field = fail loud, never silent-default.

required_fields.rationale: Core identity field — scaffolder uses this to derive page slug, folder name, and URL.
City name appears in H1, meta title, meta description, JSON-LD, and body text.
Full city name (e.g., 'Vienna, VA') used in schema areaServed and meta description.
State abbreviation used in address blocks and schema.
County name used in JSON-LD areaServed. D-10 class: wrong county = wrong service area.
Full county name (e.g., 'Fairfax County') in JSON-LD and body text.

D-12: always-required-explicit. Even cities where '45-min' IS correct must state it consciously. The scaffolder's fallback exists for backwards compat only — this gate treats any reliance on that fallback as a missing-field failure.
D-12: always-required-explicit. Companion to dispatch_time_short. Same principle — conscious value, not silent default.

D-11: always-required-explicit. Single-utility cities (Springfield = Dominion) and multi-utility cities (Stafford = Dominion/NOVEC/REC) alike must state the value consciously. The scaffolder's fallback to 'Dominion Energy coordination' exists for backwards compat only — this gate treats any reliance on that fallback as a missing-field failure, not a correct default.
Used in hero subheading and about section. Drives dispatch time logic.
Neighborhoods section is a required page section. Empty = visible gap.
Pattern cards section. Empty = visible gap in page structure.
Opening paragraph of the 'Why {city}' section.
List of nearby cities for the no-trip-charge phrase. Empty list = broken sentence.

DA2 depth-parity: per-service localized Q&A items for the Quick Reference accordion. Missing = silent-degrade to hand-authored or empty section. Every service in the build set must have its own localized depth.
DA2 depth-parity: per-service localized paragraph about the most common problem in this city. Missing = silent-degrade to generic content.
DA2 depth-parity: per-service localized neighborhood-specific problem framing. Missing = silent-degrade to generic content.
DA2 depth-parity: per-service neighborhood framing for the city's housing stock. Missing = silent-degrade to generic phrasing.
DA2 depth-parity: per-service distance/drive-time framing from HQ to this city. Missing = silent-degrade to generic distance info.
Used in JSON-LD audience. Defaults gracefully but should be explicit.
Service-specific city detail. Not all services reference this.
Optional paragraph about surrounding service areas.
Service identity. Used to derive page slug via page_slug_template.
Service name appears in headings, meta, and schema.
Template for page URL. Missing = no page slug = crash.
H1 eyebrow text template.
H2 hero heading.
Hero subheading template.
Problem cards section content. Empty = blank page section.
Process steps section. Empty = blank page section.
Pricing items list. Empty = blank pricing section.
FAQ section + FAQ schema. Empty = missing FAQ schema.
Related services cards. Empty = dead section. PR-07 class: must point to THIS client's services.
Meta title template. Missing = no SEO title.
Meta description template. Missing = no meta description.
Focus keyword for AIOSEO. Missing = no keyword targeting.
Client identity. Used to load service overrides via load_service().
Business name in schema, body, and meta.
Owner name in about section and Person schema.
Phone number in CTA buttons and body text.
tel: link for phone CTA.
Email in schema.
Base URL for page_url derivation and schema.
Brand image in schema. PR-25: must not be used as page hero.
CSS primary color. Missing = broken page styling.
Review count in schema AggregateRating. Should be current.
Review rating in schema AggregateRating.
